design: Follow-up motivated by the observed v2 class-frequency diagnostic; the public test results have been seen. This is an exploratory benchmark revision, not a new independent confirmation. Freeze all candidates here before their training; choose only by the same exact-text-unseen validation macro-F1 as v2, and do not adapt after new test scores.
features: Reuse the checksum-verified v2 vectorizer fitted on official train only; same input fields, truncation and splits. Do not refit on dev or test.
weights: w_i=(N/(148*count_train(label_i)))**power; normalize sample weights to arithmetic mean 1 using train counts only.
selection: Compare all six candidates and the frozen unweighted v2 baseline by exact-text-unseen validation macro-F1 on 148 fixed train labels. Include baseline as candidate 0; use first maximum for ties. Save selected checkpoint and all validation results before any new test scoring. If the baseline wins, retain it.
evaluation: Report selected model and frozen baseline on official test and text-unseen subset, per-class frequency bands, TCMEval exploratory transfer. All validation candidates retained; no automatic replacement of production diagnosis.
limits: No independent clinical or patient-level validation
Class weighting may trade overall accuracy for rare-label performance
No claim of paper clinical accuracy replication
